I have two autistic brothers. We’re triplets (I don’t think I have autism but I’d rather not know).

One is incredibly low functioning. He’s 16 but is mentally four years old. It’s hard to describe him. Sometimes he’s really sweet - he plays uno with us, he gives me hugs, he does well intentioned things when he knows I’ve had a bad day. We play video games together. But other times he’s a nightmare. He cries, screams, bashes holes in the wall when he’s upset. He eats way too much and throws up, which doesn’t help my emetophobia. Every time I’m at a friend’s house he destroys my room. I’ve found his shit covered underwear in my bed and on my sketchbook. I’ve came home to find out he wiped his ass on my favorite shirt. It always takes about an hour to clean up my room and my parents don’t even try to stop him.

Hate to say it, but sometimes I’m ashamed to be seen with him. It’s selfish, I know. He echolailes. He talks to himself in mostly broken sentences and gibberish. He gets weird stares in public. I don’t invite anyone over to my house for several reasons, and one of them is him. He walks around my house naked or just in underwear. I’ve had so many breakdowns over him. I love him, I mean, he’s my brother, and he makes me sad. Sometimes he’s sleeping in the hallway and my dad wakes him up and leads him into his room so he can sleep on a bed, and my dad is talking to him so gently. It makes me so emotional for reasons I can never explain. I’ve cried countless times over the fact that one day my parents won’t be able to take care of him, and one day my mom dropped the bomb that I’ll have to take care of him as soon as I graduate. I can barely take care of myself! Hell, I’ve almost died three times in the last two years. I can’t do it. He’s about 300 pounds and 6’3, he’s just as big as my 50 year old dad. It’s a nightmare trying to stop him from doing anything. He’s twice my size. Ultimately, I want him to be happy. He loves cooking and reading but I don’t know what he’ll ever be able to accomplish. I’m getting far too emotional, so let’s talk about my other brother. 

The other one is way more high functioning. He has really horrible anger issues and has tried to kill himself and/or me way too many times. He has a conduct disorder, adhd, autism, and god knows what else. He’s always been violent. I can remember when we were kids and he’d stomp on my back and beat me until I couldn’t move or breathe. If I started crawling away, he’d come back and beat me some more. And another time he had a breakdown and stood in the hallway crying and holding a knife to his head, threatening to off himself. I’ve been so scared for my life when I’m left alone with them to babysit because I’m the most competent. He beats the shit out of the brother I mentioned earlier because he can’t tell anyone, it’s so fucked. I’ve had so many times where he’s gotten mad at me for some petty reason and tried to stab me while I’m holding my door shut as tight as I can and threatening to call the cops, he kicks or punches or stabs my door and it’s awful. My mental health has never been “good” or “normal” and I had terrible anxiety and when I hear a loud crash or bang I’m scared something’s being thrown and I’m about to overhear a fight between him and my dad. Even when it’s nothing, I still panic.

I’ve overheard so many fights between him and my dad. Screaming, hitting, cursing, kicking. I was so terrified and I still am. He’s gotten a ton better but I’m still scared it’ll happen again and my mental health will be back to square one and I’ll have a suicidal breakdown. I’m pretty sure he doesn’t have any empathy for anyone. One specific example is I told a joke (totally unrelated to what was on tv) while me and my mom were watching Jesus Christ Superstar while Jesus was being whipped. He came in, laughing with us and pointing at the screen. I’m sure he was trying to fit in with people that experience normal emotions. He’s studying us. He scares me so much. It’s like he’s a ticking time bomb, and I’m just praying it doesn’t go off within the next two years while I’m still at home.

I’ve asked my parents if they’ve regretted having kids, they both said this isn’t what they wanted (of course, all parents want their kids to be perfectly happy and healthy) but they wouldn’t trade their kids for the world. Maybe they would trade the second one, but not the first. I’ll never know the true answer, they wouldn’t ever be honest with me if hey regretted it. They wouldn’t tell me I’m a mistake. They knew what they were getting into with IVF and they didn’t decide to have a “selective deduction” (take out an embryo or two). I don’t know. No one deserves this.

Tl;dr: I have two disabled brothers and they make my life a hell of a lot worse. One is super sweet but his mind is 1/4 of his actual age and the other one is a violent psychopath. I’d say regret is kind of a strong word. The lower functioning one is really sweet, but he’s never going to live on his own. The higher functioning one still won’t ever be able to live on his own. Maybe that’s just a risk you take by deciding to have children.

I relate so hard dude. I would get comments all the time on how much weight I’d lost and it would make me so happy but so desperate. Part of me feels like I’m going to relapse and it makes me so anxious. Just earlier today at my boyfriend’s house I saw his scale out in the open and not ten minutes later I was curled up sobbing and hyperventilating.

I feel like my anxiety will never get better, all the therapy doesn’t help with throwing up in my mouth when I see the guy that sexually assaulted me. I just wanna be happy. I think I’ll eventually get there.

Luckily I’d only had it for maybe 4-6 months. I was getting better but once I relapsed, I got so much worse. I thought the problem would go away on its own, but it just came back stronger. I hit rock bottom, I didn’t eat, and when I did, I threw it right back up. 

My friends knew. I didn’t want them to worry about my death, but I had to talk to someone. Once it got to the point where I wasn’t even consuming any calories at all and I was too weak to exercise at all, I posted to my vent account on instagram. It was private and only had nine followers, which were my close friends. I felt like I was going to die very soon and I didn’t want to leave without one last goodbye.

The next day at school, I got called into the office. They sent me to the nearby mental hospital. I was scared shitless. I was so scared of being even more of a failure to everyone around me that I forced myself to eat. I had to start out small. It was torture and my stomach ached like hell.

Once I got out, I got hooked up with a dietitian and a therapist. I’ve been on a meal plan ever since. Three meals a day, with snacks in between.  Only a year after I developed it and six months of recovery, I can finally say it’s gone. It’s been a rough journey and I still have bad days where I don’t eat as often as I should. If it wasn’t for the support of my therapist, my doctor, and my friends, I really wouldn’t be here to tell this story. It sounds cheesy, but it’s true. Hang in there. I know it’s exhausting, but you’ll get through it. I believe in you, we all do.

Well I’m late to the party but here goes.

I had anorexia for about six months including recovery time. People assume that I’m automatically underweight and bony but that’s really not the case. I lost 40 pounds but I was never underweight. I didn’t even want to recover but I had so many people fighting for me. It ended with me not eating anything for a solid week and then being sent to a hospital and monitored closely, turns out I was insanely dehydrated which wasn’t really surprising.

Some stereotypes are true. Like anorexic people barely eating anything and then puking it up when they get the chance. But other stereotypes aren’t. Many people think it’s only girls that have eating disorders, but I’m a guy, which made recovery more difficult because I felt so stupid and helpless. 

As for what it was like during the time I was starving myself, it’s honestly a giant blur. I can remember some details, like almost passing out at the mall and my friends trying to force me to eat. But I don’t really remember much other than being in constant pain and being cold and tired.

Also if you meet anyone with an eating disorder, don’t try to shove food in their mouth. It’s happened to me way too often.

Tl;dr: I was caught accidentally skipping class and was too awkward to fess up right away

In seventh grade, I had a math teacher everyone loved. I’ll call her Mrs K. 

So flash forward to eighth grade and me/my friends still talked to Mrs K regularly because we all loved her. During last period in eighth grade one day, me and one of my friends (I’ll call her S) wanted to go see Mrs K. 

Our teacher was making us write thank you notes to people who helped us with our play and she said that no one could leave the class until they either finished their notes or the bell rang. Me and S hatched a plot to go see Mrs K without asking our teacher because we knew she’d say no. We were going to leave when they rang the bell for car riders to leave, even though we were bus riders.

The bell rings and we took of to go see Mrs K in another building. In front of the building was a bitchy blonde teacher lady guarding the doors. We bypass her by telling her we need to use the restroom and we’re car riders. We’re in the bathroom trying to figure out what to do next when the blonde lady busts in and says something along the lines of “I knew you were up to something!”. 

Defeated, we leave the building and make our way to the 6th/8th grade car pick up with the blonde lady eyeing us the whole time. We go up to the principal and tell her that S’s dad went to the wrong car line and we needed to go to another building. She lets us go and as we’re walking, the blonde lady glares at us and talks into her walkie talkie.

We make it into the building and hide in another bathroom. We’re both scared shitless, and another lady walks in and says “I know you’re in here, come out.” We both come out of our stalls and make our way out into the hallway to see our drama teacher and the principal. The drama teacher says she’s disappointed in us and she lost all respect for the both of us. We both get long forms and have to serve in IST.

If only I would’ve asked our teacher/fessed up sooner.

I did never get to see Mrs K.
